features.name: panc1_vs_hpne_atac
features.transformation: replicate-median log1p PANC-1 minus log1p HPNE exact mean signal over GRCh38 TSS +/- 2 kb windows reverse-lifted to hg19
features.missing_value_policy: missing flag plus cohort median imputation

features.name: patient_atac_mean
features.transformation: 10% trimmed mean across 40 within-patient median log1p CPM profiles derived from 80 libraries
features.missing_value_policy: missing flag plus cohort median imputation

features.name: patient_atac_variability
features.transformation: median absolute deviation across 40 within-patient median log1p CPM profiles
features.missing_value_policy: missing flag plus cohort median placeholder; refit imputation inside training partition

features.name: panc1_vs_hpne_ctcf
features.transformation: replicate-median PANC-1 minus HPNE exact mean signed signal over reverse-lifted TSS +/- 2 kb windows
features.missing_value_policy: missing flag plus cohort median imputation

features.name: panc1_vs_hpne_h3k4me3
features.transformation: replicate-median PANC-1 minus HPNE exact mean signed signal over reverse-lifted TSS +/- 2 kb windows
features.missing_value_policy: missing flag plus cohort median imputation

features.name: panc1_vs_hpne_h3k27ac
features.transformation: replicate-median PANC-1 minus HPNE exact mean signed signal over reverse-lifted TSS +/- 2 kb windows
features.missing_value_policy: missing flag plus cohort median imputation

features.name: paad_damaging_snv_prevalence
features.transformation: unique canonical-cohort cases with a selected damaging MAF consequence divided by 165 available mutation cases

features.name: paad_amplification_prevalence
features.transformation: autosomes only: fraction of observed cases with copy number >= twice that case's autosomal protein-coding modal baseline; sex chromosomes missing

features.name: paad_deletion_prevalence
features.transformation: autosomes only: fraction of observed cases with copy number below that case's autosomal protein-coding modal baseline, including zero; sex chromosomes missing

features.name: paad_expression_tumor
features.transformation: median across the 165-case canonical cohort of log2(TPM+1); across-gene scaling deferred to split-aware model preprocessing
features.missing_value_policy: missing flag plus cohort median imputation

features.name: pancreas_crispr_dependency
features.transformation: robust aggregate across pancreatic lineage models
features.missing_value_policy: do not impute; exclude from models requiring a complete matrix
